questions.question: The expenditure of Sudha is 125% more than her savings. If her expenditure decreases by 14% and savings increase by 38%, then by what percentage does her income increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expenditure = 125% more than savings ⇒ E = 2.25S

Take S = 4 ⇒ E = 9 ⇒ Income = 13

New E = 9 × 0.86 = 7.74, New S = 4 × 1.38 = 5.52

New Income = 7.74 + 5.52 = 13.26

Increase = 0.26/13 × 100 = 2%

**∴ Answer = 2% increase**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expenditure = 125% more than savings

Expenditure decreases by 14%, Savings increase by 38%

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let savings = S

⇒ Expenditure = S + 1.25S = 2.25S

⇒ Initial income = 2.25S + S = 3.25S

⇒ New expenditure = 2.25S × 0.86 = 1.935S

⇒ New savings = S × 1.38 = 1.38S

⇒ New income = 1.935S + 1.38S = 3.315S

⇒ Increase = 3.315S − 3.25S = 0.065S

⇒ % increase = (0.065 / 3.25) × 100 = 2%

**∴ The correct answer is 2% increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Relation

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Percentage Change

New value = Old × (1 ± change%)

Ratio Trick

Convert percentages into ratios for faster calculation.

questions.question: {If } tantheta + cottheta = 4, { then } sec²theta times csc²theta { is equal to:}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (tanθ + cotθ)² = tan²θ + cot²θ + 2

4² = tan²θ + cot²θ + 2 ⇒ tan²θ + cot²θ = 14

sec²θ × csc²θ = (1 + tan²θ)(1 + cot²θ)

= 1 + tan²θ + cot²θ + 1 = 16

**∴ Answer = 16**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

tanθ + cotθ = 4

**Formula used:**

sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ and csc²θ = 1 + cot²θ

**Calculation:**

⇒ (tanθ + cotθ)² = tan²θ + cot²θ + 2

⇒ 16 = tan²θ + cot²θ + 2

⇒ tan²θ + cot²θ = 14

⇒ sec²θ × csc²θ = (1 + tan²θ)(1 + cot²θ)

⇒ = 1 + tan²θ + cot²θ + tan²θ·cot²θ

⇒ Since tanθ·cotθ = 1 ⇒ tan²θ·cot²θ = 1

⇒ = 1 + 14 + 1 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identity

sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ, csc²θ = 1 + cot²θ

Key Relation

tanθ × cotθ = 1

Square Identity

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

questions.question: If the mode of a data exceeds its mean by 77.7, then the mode exceeds the median by _____. (Use empirical formula to find the answer)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Empirical formula ⇒ Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean

Mode − Mean = 3(Median − Mean)

Given = 77.7 ⇒ Median − Mean = 77.7 ÷ 3 = 25.9

Mode − Median = 2 × 25.9 = 51.8

**∴ Answer = 51.8**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mode − Mean = 77.7

**Formula used:**

Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mode − Mean = 3 Median − 2 Mean − Mean

⇒ = 3 Median − 3 Mean

⇒ = 3(Median − Mean)

⇒ 77.7 = 3(Median − Mean)

⇒ Median − Mean = 25.9

⇒ Mode − Median = (3 Median − 2 Mean) − Median

⇒ = 2 Median − 2 Mean

⇒ = 2(Median − Mean)

⇒ = 2 × 25.9 = 51.8

**∴ The correct answer is 51.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relation

Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean

Derived Relation

Mode − Mean = 3(Median − Mean)

Quick Trick

Mode − Median = 2/3 × (Mode − Mean)

questions.question: {If } 30\% { of } 50\% { of } (4)/(7) { of a number is } 303, { find the number.}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

30% × 50% × 4/7 = (3/10 × 1/2 × 4/7)

= 6/70 = 3/35

So 3/35 of number = 303

Number = 303 × 35 ÷ 3 = 3535

**∴ Answer = 3535**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

30% of 50% of 4/7 of a number = 303

**Formula used:**

Percentage × Fraction × Number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ 30% × 50% × 4/7 × x = 303

⇒ (3/10 × 1/2 × 4/7) × x = 303

⇒ (12/140) × x = 303

⇒ (3/35) × x = 303

⇒ x = 303 × 35 ÷ 3

⇒ x = 3535

**∴ The correct answer is 3535.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

30% = 3/10, 50% = 1/2

Multiplication Rule

Successive percentages multiply together.

Reverse Calculation

If a fraction of number is known, divide to get original number.

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 105 cm, 137 cm, and 88 cm. What is its area (in cm²)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use Heron’s formula

s = (105 + 137 + 88)/2 = 165

Area = √[165 × 60 × 28 × 77]

= √[(3×5×11)(2×2×3×5)(4×7)(7×11)] = √[(2⁴×3²×5²×7²×11²)]

= 2²×3×5×7×11 = 4620

**∴ Answer = 4620**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides = 105 cm, 137 cm, 88 cm

**Formula used:**

Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]

 
 105 88 137 

 

Calculation:

⇒ s = (105 + 137 + 88)/2 = 165

⇒ s−a = 60, s−b = 28, s−c = 77

⇒ Area = √(165 × 60 × 28 × 77)

⇒ = √(53361000)

⇒ = 4620 cm2

∴ The correct answer is 4620 cm2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron’s Formula

Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]

Semi-perimeter

s = (a + b + c)/2

Usage

Used when all three sides are given.

questions.question: If the cost price of 60 guavas is equal to the selling price of 45 guavas, what is the profit percentage (rounded off to 2 decimal places)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CP of 60 = SP of 45

⇒ SP/CP = 60/45 = 4/3

Profit = (4/3 − 1) = 1/3

Profit% = (1/3) × 100 = 33.33%

**∴ Answer = 33.33% gain**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP of 60 guavas = SP of 45 guavas

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (SP − CP) ÷ CP × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP of 1 guava = 1

⇒ CP of 60 guavas = 60

⇒ SP of 45 guavas = 60

⇒ SP of 1 guava = 60 ÷ 45 = 4/3

⇒ Profit per guava = 4/3 − 1 = 1/3

⇒ Profit % = (1/3) × 100 = 33.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.33% gain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Method

Convert total CP and SP into per unit values.

Profit Formula

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Ratio Insight

If SP/CP > 1 ⇒ profit, if < 1 ⇒ loss.

questions.question: Find the single equivalent discount (rounded off to two decimal places) for successive discounts of 16%, 29% and 4%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equivalent discount = 1 − (1−0.16)(1−0.29)(1−0.04)

= 1 − (0.84 × 0.71 × 0.96)

= 1 − 0.572544 = 0.427456

= 42.75%

**∴ Answer = 42.75%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive discounts = 16%, 29%, 4%

**Formula used:**

Net factor = (1 − d₁)(1 − d₂)(1 − d₃)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Remaining price = 0.84 × 0.71 × 0.96

⇒ = 0.572544

⇒ Equivalent discount = 1 − 0.572544

⇒ = 0.427456

⇒ = 42.75%

**∴ The correct answer is 42.75%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Rule

Equivalent discount = 1 − product of remaining fractions.

Shortcut Tip

Convert % to decimals for quick multiplication.

Approximation

Round final answer to required decimal places.

questions.question: A total profit of ₹25,000 is to be distributed amongst P, Q and R such that P : Q = 2 : 1 and Q : R = 11 : 7. The share (in ₹) of R in the profit is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

P : Q = 2 : 1 and Q : R = 11 : 7

Equalize Q ⇒ P : Q = 22 : 11

So P : Q : R = 22 : 11 : 7

Total parts = 40 ⇒ R = (7/40) × 25000

**∴ Answer = 4375**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P : Q = 2 : 1

Q : R = 11 : 7

Total profit = 25000

**Formula used:**

Share = (Ratio part ÷ Total parts) × Total amount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Make Q same in both ratios

⇒ Multiply first ratio by 11 ⇒ P : Q = 22 : 11

⇒ Combine ⇒ P : Q : R = 22 : 11 : 7

⇒ Total parts = 22 + 11 + 7 = 40

⇒ Share of R = (7/40) × 25000

⇒ = 4375

**∴ The correct answer is 4375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Combination

Make common term equal before combining ratios.

Distribution Rule

Share ∝ ratio parts.

Quick Trick

Multiply ratios to match common terms.

questions.question: Simplify: (sqrt{98} + sqrt{200} - 2sqrt{8})²
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify the surds directly by extracting perfect square factors:

⇒ (√98 + √200 − 2√8)²

⇒ (7√2 + 10√2 − 4√2)²

⇒ (13√2)²

⇒ 169 × 2 = 338

**∴ The correct answer is 338.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(√98 + √200 − 2√8)²

**Calculations:**

Break down each radical into its simplest form by factoring out perfect squares:

⇒ √98 = √(49 × 2) = 7√2

⇒ √200 = √(100 × 2) = 10√2

⇒ 2√8 = 2 × √(4 × 2) = 2 × 2√2 = 4√2

Substitute the simplified values back into the given expression:

⇒ (7√2 + 10√2 − 4√2)²

Combine the like terms:

⇒ (17√2 − 4√2)²

⇒ (13√2)²

Square the combined term:

⇒ 13² × (√2)²

⇒ 169 × 2 = 338

**∴ The correct answer is 338.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simplification of Surds

A surd is simplified by identifying and extracting the largest perfect square factor from under the root: √(a² × b) = a√b.

Addition and Subtraction of Surds

Only like surds (surds having the exact same irrational part) can be added or subtracted directly: a√x + b√x = (a + b)√x.

BODMAS Rule

Always simplify the expressions inside the Brackets first before applying higher order operations like exponentiation (Order).

questions.question: Walking at (3)/(4) of his normal speed from his home, Manish is 20 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = 3/4 ⇒ Time = 4/3

Extra time = 1/3 of usual time

1/3 of usual time = 20 min

Usual time = 20 × 3 = 60 min

**∴ Answer = 60 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = 3/4 of normal

Delay = 20 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time ∝ 1 / Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = T

⇒ New time = T × (4/3)

⇒ Delay = (4T/3 − T)

⇒ = T/3

⇒ T/3 = 20

⇒ T = 60 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 60 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Relation

If speed decreases, time increases proportionally.

Delay Concept

Delay = New time − Original time.

Shortcut Rule

Extra fraction of time = (1 − speed ratio) ÷ speed ratio.

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 10 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 20 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity (Work) = LCM of 10 and 20 = 20 units.

Combined efficiency of (P + Q) = 20 ÷ 10 = 2 units/hr.

Efficiency of P = 20 ÷ 20 = 1 unit/hr.

Efficiency of Q = (P + Q) − P = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/hr.

Time required for Q to fill 1/4 of the cistern = (20 × 1/4) ÷ 1 = 5 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by pipes P and Q together to fill the cistern = 10 hours

Time taken by pipe P alone to fill the cistern = 20 hours

**Method Used:**

We use the LCM method to find the total capacity of the cistern and the individual efficiency of each pipe.

 
 

 **Pipes**
 **Hours**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 P + Q
 10
 20
 20 ÷ 10 = 2
 
 

 P
 20
 20 ÷ 20 = 1
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of Q = Combined Efficiency of (P + Q) − Efficiency of P

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/hr

⇒ Total capacity of the cistern = 20 units

⇒ Work required to fill 1/4 of the cistern = 1/4 × 20 = 5 units

⇒ Time taken by Q alone = Work required ÷ Efficiency of Q

⇒ Time taken by Q = 5 ÷ 1 = 5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns LCM Rule

Always assume the total capacity of the tank as the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the given individual times. This completely avoids fraction additions and simplifies efficiency calculations directly into integers.

Inlet vs Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills the tank and is considered to be doing positive work, whereas an outlet pipe or a leak empties the tank and does negative work. Net efficiency = Sum of inlet efficiencies − Sum of outlet efficiencies.

Time and Work Equivalence

Efficiency is simply the rate of doing work per unit time. It is inversely proportional to time. Formula to remember: Total Time Taken = Total Target Work ÷ Net Efficiency.

questions.question: What is the smallest natural number that should be added to 5023, such that a remainder of 5 is left when the resulting number is divided by each of the numbers 20, 98, 35 and 21?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required number − 5 must be divisible by 20, 98, 35, 21

LCM = 2940

So 5023 + x − 5 = multiple of 2940 ⇒ 5018 + x

Next multiple of 2940 after 5018 = 5880

x = 5880 − 5018 = 862

**∴ Answer = 862**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5023 + x leaves remainder 5 when divided by 20, 98, 35, 21

**Concept Used:**

(Number − remainder) must be divisible by all divisors

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5023 + x − 5 = 5018 + x

⇒ Find LCM of 20, 98, 35, 21

⇒ 20 = 2²×5, 98 = 2×7², 35 = 5×7, 21 = 3×7

⇒ LCM = 2²×3×5×7² = 2940

⇒ Next multiple of 2940 after 5018 = 5880

⇒ 5018 + x = 5880

⇒ x = 5880 − 5018 = 862

**∴ The correct answer is 862.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Concept

LCM is used when a number must satisfy multiple divisibility conditions.

Remainder Trick

Subtract remainder before applying LCM.

Next Multiple

Choose smallest multiple greater than given number.

questions.question: Two trains, 297 m and 243 m, in length are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 42 km/hr and the second at the rate of 66 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add

Total speed = 42 + 66 = 108 km/hr = 30 m/s

Total distance = 297 + 243 = 540 m

Time = 540 ÷ 30 = 18 sec

**∴ Answer = 18 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lengths = 297 m and 243 m

Speeds = 42 km/hr and 66 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 297 + 243 = 540 m

⇒ Relative speed = 42 + 66 = 108 km/hr

⇒ Convert ⇒ 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

⇒ Time = 540 ÷ 30 = 18 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 18 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add.

Train Rule

Total distance = sum of train lengths.

Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18.

questions.question: In a quadrilateral ABCD, angle A = 88^circ and angle B = 81^circ . The bisectors of angle C and angle D meet at O. What is the measure of angle DOC ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any quadrilateral, the angle formed by the intersection of the angle bisectors of two adjacent angles is exactly half the sum of the remaining two interior angles.

∠DOC = (∠A + ∠B) ÷ 2

∠DOC = (88° + 81°) ÷ 2

∠DOC = 169° ÷ 2

∠DOC = 84.5°

**∴ The correct answer is 84.5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 A B C D O 88° 81° x x y y ? 

**Given:**

∠A = 88°

∠B = 81°

DO and CO are the angle bisectors of ∠D and ∠C respectively.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of a quadrilateral = 360°

Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let ∠D = 2x and ∠C = 2y

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C + ∠D = 360°

⇒ 88° + 81° + 2y + 2x = 360°

⇒ 169° + 2(x + y) = 360°

⇒ 2(x + y) = 360° − 169°

⇒ 2(x + y) = 191°

⇒ x + y = 191° ÷ 2 = 95.5°

Now, considering the triangle ΔDOC formed by the bisectors:

⇒ ∠DOC + ∠ODC + ∠OCD = 180°

⇒ ∠DOC + x + y = 180°

⇒ ∠DOC + 95.5° = 180°

⇒ ∠DOC = 180° − 95.5°

⇒ ∠DOC = 84.5°

**∴ The correct answer is 84.5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Bisectors of Opposite Angles

The acute angle formed by the intersection of the angle bisectors of two opposite angles in a non-cyclic quadrilateral is equal to half the difference of the remaining two angles. Formula: Angle = |∠B − ∠D| ÷ 2

Sum of Interior Angles

For any convex polygon with n sides, the sum of all interior angles is always given by (n − 2) × 180°. For a quadrilateral (n = 4), the sum is exactly 360°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

If the quadrilateral is cyclic (all four vertices lie on a single circle), the sum of its opposite angles is strictly equal to 180°. Also, its exterior angle is exactly equal to the interior opposite angle.

questions.question: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio of 7 : 6. Eight years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 8 : 7. Find the present age of B.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio changes 7:6 → 8:7 after 8 years

Difference stays same ⇒ 1 part = 8 years

So present ratio parts = 7 and 6 ⇒ difference = 1 part = 8

Hence B = 6 × 8 = 48

**∴ Answer = 48 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present ratio = 7 : 6

After 8 years ratio = 8 : 7

**Formula used:**

Let ages = 7x and 6x

**Calculation:**

⇒ (7x + 8) / (6x + 8) = 8 / 7

⇒ 7(7x + 8) = 8(6x + 8)

⇒ 49x + 56 = 48x + 64

⇒ 49x − 48x = 64 − 56

⇒ x = 8

⇒ Present age of B = 6x = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Rule

Difference of ages remains constant over time.

Ratio Method

Assume ages as multiples of a common variable.

Equation Solving

Use cross multiplication to solve ratio equations.

questions.question: Amit and Rahul have a total of ₹50. If Amit has ₹16 more than Rahul, then find the amount with Rahul.

Linear Equations in One Variable

Direct Distribution Rule

If a total sum S is to be divided between two individuals such that one gets a difference D more than the other, the smaller share is calculated as (S − D) ÷ 2, and the larger share is (S + D) ÷ 2.

questions.question: If the third proportional of 64 and Z is 4, then what is the value of Z?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The third proportional of two numbers a and b is given by: b² ÷ a.

According to the question, the third proportional of 64 and Z is 4.

⇒ 4 = Z² ÷ 64

⇒ Z² = 256

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number (a) = 64

Second number (b) = Z

Third proportional (c) = 4

**Formula Used:**

In a continuous proportion a : b :: b : c, the Product of Extremes = Product of Means.

 64 Z 
• = Z 4 
• 
• 
• Z × Z = 64 × 4 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 64 : Z :: Z : 4

⇒ 64 ÷ Z = Z ÷ 4

⇒ Z × Z = 64 × 4

⇒ Z² = 256

⇒ Z = √256

⇒ Z = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b).

Fourth Proportional

If a : b :: c : d, then d is the fourth proportional, calculated as d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Properties of Proportion

In any proportion a : b :: c : d, the product of extremes equals the product of means (a × d = b × c).

questions.question: If the marked price of a towel is 85% more than its cost price and a discount of 20% is announced on it, then find the profit percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Marked price = 185% of CP

After 20% discount ⇒ SP = 80% of MP

SP = 185 × 80 / 100 = 148% of CP

Profit = 148 − 100 = 48%

**∴ Answer = 48% profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 85% more than CP

Discount = 20%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (100 − Discount)% ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 + 85 = 185

⇒ SP = 185 × 80 / 100 = 148

⇒ Profit = 148 − 100 = 48

⇒ Profit % = 48%

**∴ The correct answer is 48% profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

SP = CP × (1 + markup) × (1 − discount)

Profit Formula

Profit % = (SP − CP) ÷ CP × 100

Quick Tip

Convert percentages into multipliers.

questions.question: Three cubes of edges 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm are melted and formed into a single cube. What is the percentage change in the total surface area after melting and recasting?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume conserved ⇒ 3³ + 4³ + 5³ = 216 ⇒ new cube side = 6

Initial TSA = 6(9 + 16 + 25) = 300

New TSA = 6 × 6² = 216

Decrease = 300 − 216 = 84

% decrease = (84/300) × 100 = 28%

**∴ Answer = 28% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Edges = 3 cm, 4 cm, 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume = a³, TSA = 6a²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total volume = 3³ + 4³ + 5³

⇒ = 27 + 64 + 125 = 216

⇒ New cube side = ∛216 = 6 cm

⇒ Initial TSA = 6(3² + 4² + 5²)

⇒ = 6(9 + 16 + 25) = 300

⇒ New TSA = 6 × 6² = 216

⇒ Change = 300 − 216 = 84

⇒ % decrease = (84/300) × 100 = 28%

**∴ The correct answer is 28% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation

While melting, total volume remains constant.

Surface Area

TSA of cube = 6a²

Key Insight

Merging solids reduces total surface area.

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 minutes, while pipe B can empty the completely filled tank in 24 minutes. Initially, pipe A is opened and after 4 minutes, pipe B is also opened. In how much time (in minutes) will the remaining tank be filled completely?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A fills 1/12 per min ⇒ in 4 min fills 1/3

Remaining = 2/3

Net rate (A+B) = 1/12 − 1/24 = 1/24

Time for remaining = (2/3) ÷ (1/24) = 16 min

**∴ Answer = 16 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Pipe A = 12 min, Pipe B = 24 min

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

 
 

 Pipe
 Time (min)
 Total Work
 Efficiency
 
 
 
 

 A (Fill)
 12
 24
 2
 
 

 B (Empty)
 24
 −1
 
 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done by A in 4 min = 4 × 2 = 8 units

⇒ Remaining work = 24 − 8 = 16 units

⇒ Net efficiency (A+B) = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Time = 16 ÷ 1 = 16 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 16 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes Concept

Filling is positive work, emptying is negative.

Partial Work

First find work done before second pipe starts.

Net Efficiency

Add/subtract efficiencies to get final rate.

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 64, 11, 66, 98, 25, 17, 50, 75 and 62 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the Assumed Mean Method (Deviation Method) for faster calculation.

Let the assumed mean = 50.

Sum of deviations = (+14) + (−39) + (+16) + (+48) + (−25) + (−33) + 0 + (+25) + (+12) = +18

Average deviation = +18 ÷ 9 = +2

Actual Mean = 50 + 2 = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 64, 11, 66, 98, 25, 17, 50, 75, 62

Total number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 
• 
 0
 50
 100
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 Assumed Mean (50)
 
• 
 

 Actual Mean (52)
 
 Deviation Scale Mapping

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum = 64 + 11 + 66 + 98 + 25 + 17 + 50 + 75 + 62

⇒ Sum = 468

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 468 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assumed Mean Method

Mean = Assumed Mean + (Sum of deviations ÷ Number of observations). This is highly effective to simplify manual addition of large or complex numbers.

Weighted Average

When values appear with different frequencies or given weights, Mean = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ).

Combined Mean

If two distinct groups have individual means A₁ and A₂ with n₁ and n₂ number of elements, Combined Mean = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹1,000 at the rate of 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a 10% annual rate, the effective compound interest for 2 years is calculated using the successive percentage change formula: R + R + (R × R)/100.

Effective CI % = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21%.

Total Amount = Principal (100%) + CI (21%) = 121% of Principal.

Amount = 121% of 1000 = (121/100) × 1000 = 1210.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,000

Rate (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

 
• 
 
 
 +10% (+₹100) +10% (+₹110) Start (P) ₹1,000 End of Year 1 ₹1,100 End of Year 2 (A) ₹1,210 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 1000 × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ A = 1000 × (110/100)²

⇒ A = 1000 × (11/10) × (11/10)

⇒ A = 1000 × 121/100

⇒ A = 10 × 121 = 1210

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for 2 Years

For a rate of R% compounded annually, the effective compound interest rate for 2 years is directly calculated as (2R + R²/100)%.

Difference Between CI and SI for 2 Years

The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a principal P for 2 years is calculated using the formula D = P × (R/100)².

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the applied rate becomes R/2 and the compounding periods become 2T (twice the number of years).
